item.description:
A clearer answer to “What’s on tomorrow?”

  • Calendar replies now use an agenda with a clear date heading, compact time ranges, and separate event rows.
  • All-day events show “All day” instead of midnight timestamps. Overlapping meetings are marked, and longer schedules are grouped by date.
  • Schedules adapt to narrow chat windows, with readable long event names and timezone-aware times. Copying an answer preserves the complete agenda text.
  • Typographic bullet lists in other chat replies now render as separate list items while code blocks remain unchanged.

A little head start

  • The redesigned Agent Hub brings decisions, your next meeting, and follow-ups into a clearer daily briefing.
  • A dotted, gently moving mail landscape shows seven days of received messages downloaded to Cove, with your agents’ labels below. Motion respects Reduce Motion and pauses when the chart is out of view.
  • Review an email or agent draft, prepare a delegation draft, or snooze it for later. Nothing sends automatically.
  • Waiting on others surfaces recent sent threads without a reply in downloaded mail. Calendar invitations, weather, contacts, and attachments remain available on Home.

Quieter reviews, more reliable deletion

  • Uncertain agent results now stay in Agents → Activity without adding a Gmail label. A Needs review filter makes them easier to find. Existing review labels are left unchanged.
  • Clearly unrelated email no longer becomes a review solely because an attachment could not be read. Uncertain or incomplete matches still require review before an agent acts.
  • ⌘Delete can queue emails while Cove is busy. The notification distinguishes waiting from an active Gmail request, and Undo remains available until the request starts.
  • Deleting another email while a previous deletion is being sent keeps a separate undo window. Long waits restore the affected emails with an error instead of leaving a stuck notification.
